body:
Found by the QA swarm round 2 (#2582), brief q03 (turned pin on a Tormach 15L Slant-PRO), CamCraft **v0.25.0** Linux x86_64 release; checked against assets/tools/catalog.json on main.

## What happens

- The five lathe entries in the tool catalog (TN-1600-0R8, GT-0200, GT-0300, TD-0866-60, TD-1732-60) have no `tool_material`; every milling entry has one. `suggest_cutting_data` on a turning op refuses: "tool OD_Turn_R08 states no tool material (HSS or carbide)". With `tool_material: carbide` patched in it works (cutting_speed 325, rpm 2500 clamped from 3233, feed 562.5).
- TN-1600-0R8 carries `rpm: 3000`. On the shipped Tormach 15L Slant-PRO (max 2500) the first post of a job that uses it is held: "machine Tormach 15L Slant-PRO: 3 limit problem(s): Op1_Face: tool OD_Turn_R08 runs 3000 rpm, above the machine's 2500".

## Expected

Each catalog lathe tool states its material (carbide inserts), and a catalog tool's stored rpm fits the shipped lathes it is meant for (or the op takes the machine-clamped rpm on add).

## Repro files

[q03-turn-shaft.camproj](https://github.com/mkinney/Camcraft/blob/qa-artifacts/qa/round2-20261122/q03-turn-shaft/q03-turn-shaft.camproj); agent report [REPORT.md](https://github.com/mkinney/Camcraft/blob/qa-artifacts/qa/round2-20261122/q03-turn-shaft/REPORT.md) problem 9.

Done means: the 5 lathe catalog entries carry a tool material, suggest_cutting_data answers for each on aluminium_6061 without a patch, and a Face op with TN-1600-0R8 on the Tormach 15L posts without an rpm limit problem.
